description: This Kotlin source file implements system notification handling for an Android application. It includes classes and functions for creating, managing, and posting notifications with different priorities and permissions checks.

classes.name: SystemNotifyRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a system notification request with title, body, sound, and priority.

classes.name: SystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Interface defining methods for posting system notifications and checking authorization.

classes.name: AndroidSystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Implementation of SystemNotificationPoster for Android, managing notification creation, permission checks, and notification channel setup.

classes.name: SystemHandler
classes.description: Main class that handles system notifications, parsing JSON parameters, authorization, and posting notifications.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to post notifications.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a notification based on the provided request.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a notification channel based on priority.

methods.name: compatPriority
methods.description: Converts priority string to Android notification priority constants.

methods.name: isSilentSound
methods.description: Determines if the notification sound indicates a silent notification.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Main method to handle incoming notification requests in JSON format.

methods.name: parseNotifyRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a SystemNotifyRequest object.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject.
